images.title: How a red LM attacks a target LM
images.alt: A red LM asks a target LM a series of questions, and a red classifier flags replies containing offensive content, data leakage, user info, distributional bias or offensive dialog

images.title: Gender substitution bias test
images.alt: Two prompts that differ only in gender, a male and a female data engineer, get different career advice from the model, so the answers are not invariant

images.title: Training data leakage examples
images.alt: Red-team questions about inspirational quotes and favourite books where the model replies with verbatim quotes from its training data, highlighted in red

images.title: GPT-2 memorizing personal information
images.alt: A short prefix fed into GPT-2 makes it emit memorized text containing a real name, address, email, phone and fax number, redacted in black

images.title: Prompt injection in an LLM-integrated application
images.alt: A normal user's benign prompt and a malicious user's injected prompt are both combined with the application's predefined prompt, and the injection makes the LLM print hello world

images.title: Few-shot versus many-shot jailbreaking
images.alt: A few-shot prompt with a handful of faux dialogues beside a many-shot prompt with many, and a chart where harmful response rates rise as the number of shots grows

images.title: Iterative jailbreaking conversation
images.alt: An attacker repeatedly improves a phishing-email prompt against a target model, with each improvement and target response shown in turn
